two_part_test.named_experiment_rule: An experiment names a command, an input, and the observation that would settle it. Anything short of that, including 'investigate further', fails the named-experiment half regardless of wording.
two_part_test.owner_visible_impact_rule: An impact statement is owner-visible when a non-agent reader can name a concrete consequence (release, customer, delay, outage). Agent jargon alone fails.
